title: Numerical experiments for Pulsatile Flows for Simplified Smart Fluids with Variable Exponent Power-Law
description: FEniCS/DOLFIN source code, runner scripts, plotting scripts, and regenerated figures for the numerical experiments in Sections 7.1--7.3 of the article "Pulsatile Flows for Simplified Smart Fluids with Variable Exponent Power-Law: Analysis and Numerics".
